result.reason: The redline appropriately extends use to contractors and permits assignment to an M&A successor, satisfying key scope and fallback transfer points. However, it does not provide that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. The assignment exception is also unnecessarily mutual and could alter Sparkling’s counterparty without consent; moreover, allowing either party to assign “the licence granted hereunder” is imprecise because Garman is the licensor, not the licence holder.
